ui_bugs.issue: After deleting a freshly created announcement via admin-ann-delete-<id> + confirm-ok, the row remains visible in the list (load('refresh') runs but item still returned by GET /api/announcements). If backend does soft-delete (is_active=false), screen should filter it out or refetch active-only. If backend hard-deletes, list state is stale.

Creating an existing mapping (mgr_test→ahmet already seeded) produced no user-facing feedback: no formError set and no new row diff. Either add duplicate detection (409 handling) or refresh the list to surface state. Not blocking.

issues: ScreenHeader with testID='settings-back' remains mounted (2 DOM instances) after navigating between admin panels because Expo Router keeps stacked screens; Playwright strict/first-match becomes non-visible. Consider unmounting hidden stack screens or narrowing the testID with the current screen name.
